sources_considered.why: Official retrospective mortality data provide context. They cannot settle a forecast with no deadline or establish technological necessity.
Read for cancer trends; it does not test the necessity of the proposed future changes.
Read during the related assessment. A screening improvement in one cancer does not satisfy the early-resolution rule.

evidence_items.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
evidence_items.explanation: The latest mortality year on this official page documents substantial historical burden. It does not establish what happened after the forecast or which future advances are necessary.

unresolved_gaps: The search found no documented achievement meeting the early-resolution rule by 2026-10-28.
There is no causal demonstration that every proposed category of change is necessary.
The forecast supplies neither a deadline nor precise definitions of its endpoint and prerequisites.
